what: Give the owner one weekly line on what the front desk did with prices: discounts given and joining fees skipped, by person (for example "Ramesh gave 6 discounts, Rs 1,800 off")
why: The server already stamps who sold each plan and caps the desk at 10% off, but nothing adds those up for the owner; the weekly summary and Today never mention discounts
impact_why: Staff leakage is the top fear of Indian gym owners who are not at the desk; this is the line that makes them trust the desk login
my_view: My view: do it; the data is already on every receipt and plan, it is one sum by person added to the Monday summary. Show it only to the owner, never the desk.

what: When a member scans the gym poster and their number is not on the gym list, offer "Send my details to the gym" (the existing Join online request) instead of only "Ask the desk to add you, then scan again"
why: Today the server keeps only a count of these scans (gym and time) and the app ends at a dead end; the person standing at the door is often a new walk-in or a member whose number the desk typed wrong
impact_why: Catches walk-ins and wrong numbers at the moment they are in the gym; the desk gets a ready enquiry instead of a spoken request it may forget
my_view: My view: do it, but reuse Join online exactly (verified number, gym plans, lands in Enquiries); never put the typed number into the gym list by itself.

what: Send the "plan ends soon / today / ended" reminders from the server, like gym messages and plan approvals already are, instead of the member phone scheduling them from the last plan end it saw
why: The phone schedules these itself from what it last knew; a renewal at the desk reaches the phone only when the app is opened again, so a just-renewed member can still get "your plan ended", and a member who stopped opening the app gets nothing. Pop-ups from the server already exist for messages, approvals, orders and plans
impact_why: Renewal reminders are the reminders that bring money back; a wrong "ended" after paying makes the gym look careless
my_view: My view: first check on a phone whether a desk renewal really leaves a stale reminder (not checked here). If it does, move only the plan-end cases to the server and keep the rest on the phone.

what: Let a gym message point at one thing in the app: a shop product, the running workout offer, Renew my plan or Gym timings, shown as one button under the message
why: A message is only a title and up to 300 letters of text; an offer message cannot open the offer or the product it is about, so the member has to find it
impact_why: Offer and event messages are the gym's main sales tool in the app; one tap from message to product or offer is where the sale happens
my_view: My view: do it after the "Ask about this" button idea for the phone; keep the choice to a fixed list of places in the app, never a free web link (no spam or phishing through a gym).

what: Let the owner ask to close the gym and erase its data from the panel itself (a "Close my gym" request with the download-first step), feeding the existing delete-request list
why: The delete-request list today is filled by HQ by hand from a feedback note, an email or a call; an owner has no clear button and no status of the request
impact_why: Rare, but when it happens it is a legal right and a trust moment; a clear button and a status line avoid an angry owner
my_view: My view: do it as a request only: the owner presses, HQ still calls the gym and does the 30-day count as now. Never let the button delete by itself.

what: Undo a whole data import in one server step ("Undo this import: 142 members, 160 plans, 158 receipts"), all or nothing, instead of the panel deleting record by record
why: The server allows deleting imported records one at a time; an undo cut off by a bad connection leaves half an import behind with no count of what is left
impact_why: Used rarely, but a half-undone import mixes wrong and right members, which is hard to clean by hand
my_view: My view: do it only if the panel really sends one delete per record (check before building); otherwise leave it.

what: Delete demo gyms that nobody signed up for and nobody used for 30 days, the way the nightly job already deletes the test gyms
why: "Start demo" makes a real gym with a sample shop and a key, with no sign-up; only gyms named "QA " are ever cleaned, so every demo stays for ever and fills HQ's gym list and counts
impact_why: Keeps HQ's new-gym numbers honest and removes free storage that strangers can use (see the existing demo-gym photo finding)
my_view: My view: do it with a safe rule: no signed-in person, no record saved and no member join in 30 days; anything with real use is kept and shown to HQ instead.

what: Do not build automatic trial extensions; keep trials at 3 months with HQ extending by hand up to 6, and spend the effort on the trial-ending call lines in HQ instead
why: Mindbody and Glofox (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live) run short fixed trials with a sales call, not self-extending ones; MettleUp already never locks a gym when the trial ends, so an automatic extension only delays the paying talk
impact_why: Avoids building a feature that lowers conversion; keeps the owner in charge of who gets more time
my_view: My view: agree with the current design; the HQ "trials ending in 3 days" line already proposed is the better lever.
